purpose: one zero-network rejection-first adjudication of every unique directed three-asset Binance Spot cycle in the already retained complete public graph

retained_inputs.network_policy: no new request; consume only the exact retained complete public responses above

universe.definition: every unique directed three-asset closed cycle constructible from active Spot pairs; cyclic rotations are one cycle and reverse direction remains distinct
universe.valuation_gate: every cycle asset must have a direct retained USDT conversion rate

activity_gate.meaning: rejection only; activity does not prove executable sequential fills

execution_model.rounding: sequential exact LOT_SIZE rounding for every leg
execution_model.capacity: each leg must fit within displayed top-of-book quantity after prior-leg rounding
execution_model.residual: all rounded residual input is independently valued in USDT and must not exceed 1 basis point of starting notional

candidate_gate.ordering: candidate and feasibility gates precede economic ranking

requires_before_acceptance: an independent non-overlapping prospective paper or owned-fill window
explicit sequential latency atomicity and unwind-loss controls
positive economics after every execution cost and operational stress
prohibited_shortcuts: treating a zero-fee upper-bound candidate as profitable
selecting a static cycle from this retained outcome
rerunning the same retained population after seeing the outcome
using credentials placing orders mutating accounts or creating volume
